note: Each URL was probed by HEAD (or a 1-byte ranged GET); no payload was downloaded and no credentials were sent. `unreachable`, a WAF challenge and a Google Drive page are no information and keep the prior state. A reachable landing page is not evidence that the data is public. `released_after_audit` and `still_unreleased` come only from a dated reading of public pages by the implementing agent (not human-reviewed, not a probe); the latest such reading stands unless a pinned data file appears.
pin_rule: pinned = latest status `reachable` and (a digest, or a strong ETag that does not start with W/ together with a known content length); `now_public_pinnable` also needs a data file or archive content type, never an HTML page or document

legend.unchanged: the recorded state stands: no new information, or the answer says nothing about the files
legend.now_public_pinnable: a data file answers without credentials and carries a pin; a candidate for integration only
legend.public_unpinned: a recorded page answers without credentials and nothing on a data file is pinned; this does not establish that the data itself is public
legend.now_gated: a source answered 401/403 (or an agent reading found a gate) on an entry not recorded as gated; unconfirmed
legend.released_after_audit: an agent reading of public pages found a release; not human-reviewed, identity not verified
legend.still_unreleased: an agent reading of public pages located no public release; not human-reviewed

record_signal_rule: case-insensitive keyword rule over the entry's own blockers, rights note and earlier source_audit_* notes (never the refresh items); it lists what the record already says and never changes a disposition

selection.rule: merged coverage preview_count == 0 and preview == none and access != unreleased

The paper's '53 internet-sourced hidden-content images' match wild/ by count only; the paper page links no release, so the match is not verified.

Public and not gated (page read without signing in; nothing downloaded). The same wild/ files are already prepared under the hc-bench entry at a pinned revision, so no separate acquisition is needed. The registry's 2026-10-06 relationship on this entry records the repository as context, not the paper's collection, and the two stay distinct until exact image IDs show that the paper's 53 images are wild/; the count match alone does not. Read by the implementing agent, not human-reviewed.
Hugging Face card tags MIT. Rights to the underlying internet-sourced photographs are not stated and need item review; public media display is not approved.

agent_readings.note: Benchmark introduced by Girrbach et al. (arXiv 2410.19314): 5,000 images, 1,000 each from FairFace, MIAP, PHASE and PATA (FairFace in two padding variants), balanced for gender and, where annotated, ethnicity, with trait, skill and occupation prompts. The author repository holds code and a setup_data.sh recipe.

The README directs users to run setup_data.sh, which downloads and processes the source datasets (about 100 GB of disk and about 24 hours per the README). It offers no hosted copy of the 5,000 selected images; the recipe is public, but each source dataset keeps its own access route.
The README text read states no licence. The images come from FairFace, MIAP, PHASE and PATA, whose own terms apply; redistribution of the selected images is not approved here.

agent_readings.note: VTAB is the Visual Task Adaptation Benchmark of Zhai et al. (arXiv 1910.04867): 19 classification tasks assembled from existing public datasets (for example Caltech101, CIFAR-100, CLEVR, EuroSAT, KITTI, SUN397, SVHN). It is a benchmark suite with no single release. The registry's survey excerpt ('CUB200, VTAB (Pruthi et al., 2020) ResNet-56') is a flattened table fragment, so its trailing citation is not an attribution of VTAB; the survey names VTAB only as a dataset of a cited study, and which VTAB tasks that study used is not established here.

The code repository loads the member datasets through TensorFlow Datasets; its README says Diabetic Retinopathy and Resisc45 cannot be downloaded automatically. There is no single VTAB archive to pin; each member dataset has its own source.
The code is Apache-2.0 per the repository. The data keep the terms of each member dataset; no benchmark-wide data licence is stated.
